name: Clusterio
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Clusterio, which links Factorio servers into one cluster. Install a controller (the web interface) on one server and hosts, which run the Factorio games, on others.
startup: b=node_modules/.bin; set_cfg() { jq "$@" "$cfg" > "$cfg.new" && mv -f "$cfg.new" "$cfg"; }; if [ "{{SERVER_MODE}}" = controller ]; then cfg=config-controller.json; set_cfg --argjson p {{SERVER_PORT}} --arg n "{{CLUSTER_NAME}}" '."controller.http_port" = $p | ."controller.name" = $n' && exec $b/clusteriocontroller run --log-level {{LOG_LEVEL}}; else cfg=config-host.json; a="{{PUBLIC_ADDRESS}}"; [ -n "$a" ] || a=$(curl -fsS4 --max-time 5 https://api.ipify.org || echo localhost); r="{{FACTORIO_PORTS}}"; [ -n "$r" ] || r="{{SERVER_PORT}}-{{SERVER_PORT}}"; set_cfg --arg n "{{HOST_NAME}}" --arg u "{{CONTROLLER_URL}}" --arg t "{{CONTROLLER_TOKEN}}" --arg a "$a" --arg r "$r" '."host.name" = $n | ."host.controller_url" = $u | ."host.public_address" = $a | ."host.factorio_port_range" = $r | if $t != "" then ."host.controller_token" = $t else . end' && exec $b/clusteriohost run --log-level {{LOG_LEVEL}}; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Clusterio. Installs (or updates) Clusterio's controller or host from npm,
# with the plugins listed. On a host it also downloads Factorio's headless
# server from factorio.com, checked against Factorio's published checksum.
# Configs, the database, instances, saves and mods are never touched once
# they exist.
set -euo pipefail
export npm_config_update_notifier=false
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
mode="${SERVER_MODE:-controller}"
case "$mode" in controller | host) ;; *) fail "Mode must be controller or host." ;; esac
b=node_modules/.bin
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

# Node.js to install with, kept only for the install: the server runs on
# the image's own Node.js.
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) narch=x64 dist=linux64 file=linux ;;
aarch64) narch=arm64 dist=linux-arm64 file=linux-arm64 ;;
*) fail "Clusterio's install has no Node.js for $(uname -m)." ;;
esac
nodes=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt) || fail "nodejs.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
read -r nsum nfile < <(grep -E " node-v[0-9.]+-linux-$narch\.tar\.xz$" <<<"$nodes")
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/node.tar.xz" "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$nfile"
[ "$(sha256sum "$build/node.tar.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$nsum" ] || fail "The Node.js download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
mkdir -p "$build/node"
tar -xJf "$build/node.tar.xz" -C "$build/node" --strip-components=1
export PATH="$build/node/bin:$PATH"

[ -f package.json ] || echo '{ "name": "clusterio-install", "private": true }' > package.json
pkgs=("@clusterio/$mode@latest" "@clusterio/ctl@latest")
for p in ${PLUGINS:-}; do
    [[ $p =~ ^(@[a-z0-9._-]+/)?[a-z0-9._-]+(@[A-Za-z0-9._^~-]+)?$ ]] || fail "$p isn't an npm package name."
    pkgs+=("$p")
done
echo "Installing ${pkgs[*]}"
npm install --no-fund --no-audit --loglevel=error "${pkgs[@]}"

if [ "$mode" = controller ]; then
    if [ ! -f config-controller.json ]; then
        $b/clusteriocontroller config create
        admin="${ADMIN_STRING:-admin}"
        $b/clusteriocontroller bootstrap create-admin "$admin"
        token=$($b/clusteriocontroller bootstrap generate-user-token "$admin" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
        echo "The admin account is $admin. Its login token for the web interface:"
        echo "$token"
    fi
else
    [ -f config-host.json ] || $b/clusteriohost config create
    # Factorio's headless server, which the host's instances run.
    want="${FACTORIO_VERSION:-latest}"
    if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
        want=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://factorio.com/api/latest-releases | jq -r '.stable.headless') ||
            fail "factorio.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    sums=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://factorio.com/download/sha256sums/) || fail "factorio.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    sum=$(awk -v f="factorio-headless_${file}_$want.tar.xz" '$2 == f { print $1 }' <<<"$sums")
    [ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Factorio has no headless server $want for this CPU. Set Factorio version to latest, or to a release such as 2.0.72."
    if [ "$(cat factorio/.raptor-factorio 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ]; then
        echo "Factorio $want is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading Factorio $want (headless)"
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/factorio.tar.xz" "https://factorio.com/get-download/$want/headless/$dist"
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/factorio.tar.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The Factorio download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        tar -xJf "$build/factorio.tar.xz" -C "$build"
        rm -rf factorio
        mv "$build/factorio" factorio
        echo "$sum" > factorio/.raptor-factorio
    fi
fi
echo "Installed the Clusterio $mode $(node -p 'require("@clusterio/'"$mode"'/package.json").version')."

variables.name: Mode
variables.description: controller runs the cluster and its web interface; host runs Factorio games for a controller.

variables.name: Admin account
variables.description: The admin account the controller is created with (its Factorio username). Its login token is shown in the install log.

variables.name: Cluster name
variables.description: The cluster's name, shown in the web interface (controller).

variables.name: Host name
variables.description: This host's name in the web interface (host).

variables.name: Controller URL
variables.description: The controller's web address, with its port, such as the controller server's IP and port 8080 (host).

variables.name: Controller token
variables.description: Optional: without one, the host asks the controller to approve it and shows the approval link in the console (host).

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The address players join this host's games on. Empty finds the server's public IPv4 address at every start (host).

variables.name: Factorio ports
variables.description: The UDP ports the host's games use, such as 34100-34110; allocate them to the server too. Empty uses the server's port, enough for one game (host).

variables.name: Factorio version
variables.description: The Factorio headless server a host installs, such as 2.0.72, or latest.

variables.name: Plugins
variables.description: Clusterio plugins to install from npm, separated by spaces, such as @clusterio/plugin-global_chat.
